deliverables: WP1 - Plutarch and Ply Maintenance, Compatibility & Developer Experience
Critical breakages and serious vulnerability response
Bug fixes, correctness improvements, and optimizations
Documentation, examples, technical blog posts, and developer-experience improvements
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address for the MLabs Plutarch/Ply project funding process
request.what: Annual funding for maintenance and enhancement of Plutarch and Ply, including maintenance, compatibility, developer experience, documentation, bug fixes, optimizations, and response to critical breakages or vulnerabilities.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,162,746 ada, consisting of 1,128,880 ada for Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility, and developer experience plus a 33,866 ada Intersect administration fee.

Plutarch is described as a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts by controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply is described as tooling for serializing Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.

MLabs says Plutarch and Ply have been extensively used in the Cardano ecosystem and reports a recent internal audit finding at least 26 teams using them in the motivation section and at least 15 teams in the rationale section.
The proposal says Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in MLabs' public cross-language benchmark suite while using comparatively low on-chain compute and memory.
The proposal states that if Plutarch and Ply fall behind Cardano ledger and Plutus/UPLC evolution, adopters may face more friction, migration risk, bespoke workarounds, or avoidable rewrites.

The proposal says it will prioritize resources first to critical breakages and serious vulnerabilities, then protocol-era and hard-fork compatibility, then bug fixes and optimizations, then documentation and developer-experience improvements.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal states the requested withdrawal does not, alone or in aggregate at submission time, breach the 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

The document states that oversight and milestone-based disbursement controls will be provided through Intersect, technically capable third parties, and a smart contract framework with specified admin, leadership, and external oversight committee approvals.

The proposal discloses prior MLabs treasury or ecosystem funding for Plutarch/Ply, GrumpleStiltSkin, Cardano.nix, Project Catalyst awards, and 70,000 ada from Intersect for Conway-era Plutarch updates.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ada for MLabs Plutarch and Ply maintenance through Intersect, provides a budget split, describes technical scope and prioritization, claims ecosystem adoption and benchmark performance, cites Intersect voting and NCL compliance, and describes treasury smart contract oversight and prior funding disclosures.
